title: Fake Taxi QR
scenario: A taxi sticker QR asks you to prepay the ride before the driver starts.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Fake Taxi QR: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Use official taxi apps, meters, or verified payment terminals.
